summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.1 (Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package) via the GSD workflow, executing 6 plans across 5 waves. The bulk of the session was spent debugging and fixing integration failures discovered during the Plan 19.1-05 checkpoint verification — rewiring web app hooks to use the new SDK.
summary.outcome: 10 atomic commits fixing SDK-web app integration, with 9/10 operations verified working (create folder, rename, upload, download, edit, rename file, move, delete). Delete-to-bin was diagnosed and fixed last. Plan 19.1-06 was not started; the checkpoint for Plan 19.1-05 was not formally closed and the phase execution workflow is still paused.

repo: The web app has a dual-path IPNS write problem: old services and new SDK both write to the same IPNS records with independent sequence counters, causing 409 conflicts on any interleaved operation.

`setApiClientConfig()` from `@cipherbox/api-client` must be called before any generated API functions (including IPNS operations). It was never wired into the SDK init path, silently failing all IPNS-dependent SDK operations.
FolderEntry.id is a UUID used for UI navigation and store lookups; ipnsName (k51...) is for IPNS operations. These must not be conflated when storing new folders.
`CipherBoxClient.deleteToBin()` requires `binState` to be non-null (loaded via `loadBin()`). If `loadBin()` returns null (no IPNS record yet), deleteToBin silently falls back to hard `deleteItem()`.
The old `initializeBin()` service creates the bin IPNS record lazily on first delete; the SDK's `loadBin()` must be called *after* this completes or it will find no record and return null.

`ensureFolderRegistered` caused a cascade of bugs by overwriting SDK's correct IPNS private key and sequence number with stale Zustand store values. The safest pattern is: skip entirely if SDK already has the folder.
The `useDropUpload` hook had 3 separate `useUploadStore` selector calls; collapsing to 1 is required to avoid React HMR hook count errors when the hook is rewritten.

The web app's old download/resolve path (`file-metadata.service.ts` → `ipns.service.ts`) uses the web app's own axios instance, not `@cipherbox/api-client`. Files uploaded via SDK but downloaded via the old path fail to decrypt because the IPNS resolution uses a different code path.

The `@cipherbox/web` app should depend on `@cipherbox/sdk` only, not `@cipherbox/sdk-core` directly. Leaking sdk-core into the web app is an architectural smell — functionality should be surfaced via the SDK client.
IPNS delegated routing retries add 20-30s per integration test run against the live API. This is normal and not a test infra bug.
OTP rate limit is 5 sends per 15-minute window, stored in Redis. Clearing the rate limit key allows test re-runs without waiting.

code.finding: Two fixes added: (1) `setApiClientConfig({ baseUrl, getAccessToken })` called during SDK init so all `@cipherbox/api-client` generated functions have a working axios instance; (2) `client.loadBin()` called after old `initializeBin()` completes (non-blocking) so SDK bin state is populated before first delete.

`loadBin()` previously returned `null` when no IPNS record existed (fresh account). Changed to return an empty `BinState` so `deleteToBin()` can succeed on first use without requiring a pre-existing IPNS bin record.

Extended with `hasFolder()`, `getFolderSequenceNumber()`, `getFolderIpnsPrivateKey()`, and `downloadFromIpns()`. `createFolder()` return type extended to include `id` (UUID from FolderEntry) and `ipnsPrivateKey` so callers don't have to use empty placeholder keys.
`ensureFolderRegistered` simplified to a no-op if `client.hasFolder(folder.ipnsName)` — prevents overwriting SDK's sequence number and IPNS private key with stale store data.
`handleCreate` must use `result.id` (UUID) not `result.ipnsName` for the Zustand store entry. Navigation uses the UUID to look up folders in the children array, not the IPNS name.
Complete rewrite to use `client.uploadFile()` instead of old two-step encrypt+upload+addFilePointer service chain. Eliminates the dual-path IPNS write problem for file uploads.
Simplified to use `client.downloadFromIpns()`. Old `downloadFileFromIpns` service path removed from this hook.
Owner file path now uses `client.downloadFromIpns()`. Share path still uses old service because it requires re-wrapped file keys from share_keys — not yet migrated.

`updateFolderMetadataAndPublish` now retries once on 409 by re-resolving the current IPNS sequence number via `resolveIpnsRecord`. Handles stale seq numbers from any source without requiring callers to manage retry logic.

Full SDK lifecycle integration test against live API: login via test-login endpoint → create folder → upload → download (content verified) → rename → delete → bin lifecycle. Uses `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` env var. Runtime ~27s due to IPNS delegated routing.

workflow: When a checkpoint verification reveals bugs, validate fixes at the SDK unit/integration level first (vitest against live API), then use Playwright MCP for UI verification. This gives a faster feedback loop than starting with E2E browser tests.
Headed Playwright via MCP tools is effective for browser verification without requiring the user to drive the UI. The assistant can navigate, interact, and read console errors autonomously.
Use random emails per Playwright test run to get a clean vault state. Avoids state pollution from prior runs that causes misleading failures.
OTP retrieval in dev: send OTP via curl, read from the server log file output path. Rate limiting (5/15min in Redis) can be cleared manually if needed for test iteration.
Atomic commits per fix (not per session or per wave) makes it easy to bisect and revert individual changes. Stash + selective staging works well when a file contains multiple orthogonal fixes.

When the SDK's internal state can be queried (e.g., `hasFolder`, `getFolderSequenceNumber`), expose those as methods rather than relying on Zustand store as the source of truth — the store lags behind SDK mutations.

The GSD workflow's dual-path architecture (old service + new SDK) is a migration hazard. Any operation where both paths write to the same IPNS record will produce 409 conflicts. Fully migrate each operation atomically rather than running them in parallel.

friction: Web3Auth OTP login in test environment is fragile: rate limiting (5/15min), session expiry, and duplicate DB key errors for reused emails all blocked Playwright verification sessions.
No direct access to API process stdout — OTP retrieval required curl + log file polling, which only works if the log file path is known and the process writes there.
Long IPNS delegated routing delays (~30s per integration test run) slow iteration significantly.
The `ensureFolderRegistered` bridge pattern caused 4 separate bugs before being simplified to skip-if-has. Each 'fix' introduced a new edge case (wrong seq, wrong private key, wrong UUID).
React HMR hook count errors when rewriting hooks mid-session (caused by inconsistent `useUploadStore` call count in `useDropUpload`) were confusing and hard to attribute to the right cause.
ESM `__dirname` not available in Playwright test spec file — required `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` workaround.
User had to push back multiple times before the assistant stopped asking them to manually drive the UI for verification.
The initial plan 02 execution was discarded and the branch reset — the plan had been updated between planning and execution but the executor used the stale version.
open_items: Plan 19.1-06 (final cleanup, import rewiring, release config) not yet executed — phase execution workflow is paused at the Plan 19.1-05 checkpoint.
Plan 19.1-05 checkpoint not formally approved — the GSD orchestrator never received an 'approved' signal to continue to Wave 5.
`TextEditorDialog` share path still uses the old `downloadFileFromIpns` service because it requires re-wrapped file keys from share_keys. Needs SDK support for shared file download.
Duplicate file handling in `useDropUpload` still uses old encrypt+upload path (doesn't register in folder until user confirms Replace dialog) — not migrated to SDK.
`useFileDelete` not migrated to SDK — kept on old service pattern because the delete flow is architecturally different for shared files.

Pre-existing DTS circular dependency between `@cipherbox/core` and `@cipherbox/crypto` causes `pnpm -r run build` to fail. Only `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web build` works. Noted as deviation in Plan 05 SUMMARY but not fixed.
The `.learnings/` directory and `README.md` index were created but may need a more systematic cross-session index if it grows large.

Integration test runtime of ~27s is acceptable for now but IPNS resolution performance should be profiled — multiple delegated routing retries per operation suggest the API's IPNS resolution is slow in the test environment.
